lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still in space, deep violet sky, teal glow, pale lilac rock.
notes: Mood-only mini images for Planetary Ring Miner.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen "Planetary Ring Miner-mini" --model sdxl --max 999, then finish "Planetary Ring Miner-mini" --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: ring
images.prompt: A ring of glittering rocks circling a huge violet alien planet.

images.name: gleaner
images.prompt: A long flat rectangular robot mining ship with two big thrusters underneath, floating in space.

images.name: net
images.prompt: A glowing teal forcefield grid boxing in a cluster of asteroids in orbit.

images.name: site
images.prompt: An asteroid crumbling into streams of glittering sand under teal laser fire.

images.name: cluster
images.prompt: A cluster of strange crystal-covered asteroids drifting above a planet's atmosphere.

images.name: base
images.prompt: A busy orbital home base with docking bays and cargo containers, a planet below.

images.name: break

images.name: crumble
